highlights_headline: The 4.155 development line modernizes GLES interop signatures and updates bundled HarfBuzz.
highlights_body: The renderer-facing interop surface now uses pointer-based signatures, and HarfBuzz advances to version 14.4.0.

bullets.detail: Updates the GLES interop declarations to use pointer-based signatures for native graphics integrations.
Refreshes the bundled text-shaping engine to HarfBuzz 14.4.0.
